outcome: Total adverse outcome (preterm birth + post-term birth)
cohort: The cohort consisted of 3,100,122 singleton pregnant women from the National Vital Statistics System (NVSS) in 2019.
finding: Both low and high gestational weight gain z-scores were positively associated with preterm birth and total adverse outcomes, while low GWG z-score was positively associated with an increased risk of post-term birth and higher GWG z-scores were associated with a decreased risk of post-term birth.
